name: Gol'dir
summary: In Tarren Mill, Krusk has found where Gol'dir is held. The documents point to a large Syndicate base up north, possibly in the Alterac Mountains, and Gol'dir has been captive too long.

sections.title: A Trail to the North
sections.body: In Tarren Mill, Krusk has studied the documents you brought back after Infiltration. They point to a large Syndicate base up north, possibly in the Alterac Mountains. Gol'dir has been held too long, and Krusk wants him freed.

sections.title: The Inn at Strahnbrad
sections.body: Gol'dir is held in the top room of the inn at Strahnbrad, where Syndicate fill the building. A Rusted Iron Key opens the lock. Jailor Borhuin carries it and may be in any building in town.

sections.title: What Gol'dir Says
sections.body: Gol'dir says the Warchief's orders sent him leading an expedition out of Durotar, but the plans went awry. The Syndicate kept him in Strahnbrad, forcing him to haul burdens and dig. He brushes aside his suffering; important information must reach whoever now leads the group.

faq.answer: The Syndicate holds Gol'dir in a large base to the north.
Gol'dir is imprisoned in the top room of the inn at Strahnbrad, which is packed with Syndicate.
A Rusted Iron Key opens Gol'dir's lock. Jailor Borhuin carries it and may be in any building in Strahnbrad.

faq.q: What came before this step in the chain?
faq.answer: Before this step, you procured documents during Infiltration that point to where Gol'dir is held.
